    security_visitor_overview->'visitor_statistics'->>'visitor_flow' as vflow,
    CASE WHEN security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'cctv_coverage' IN ('Full','Active','Armed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
    CASE WHEN security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'access_control' IN ('Full','Active','Armed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
    CASE WHEN security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'alarm_status' IN ('Full','Active','Armed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
    CASE WHEN security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'motion_detection' IN ('Full','Active','Armed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as weak_count
FROM "ExhibitionHalls"
WHERE security_visitor_overview->'visitor_statistics'->>'visitor_flow' NOT IN ('Low')
  AND (
    CASE WHEN security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'cctv_coverage' IN ('Full','Active','Armed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
    CASE WHEN security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'access_control' IN ('Full','Active','Armed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
    CASE WHEN security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'alarm_status' IN ('Full','Active','Armed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
    CASE WHEN security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'motion_detection' IN ('Full','Active','Armed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
  ) >= 3
ORDER BY "Hall_ID";
